Name: Heart Album (A Photo Album)
Author: Ncyde
Description:
[center][b][color=#f4cccc][size=5]HEART [/size][/color][color=#e06666][size=5]♥[/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3] [/color][size=5]ALBUM[/size]
[color=#8e7cc3][img]https://i.imgur.com/uvbW1Fg.gif[/img][/color][size=5]﻿[/size]


[color=#8e7cc3]F[/color][color=#b4a7d6]eatures[/color][size=5]:[/size]
[size=5]OPEN THE ALBUM PRESSING[/size][size=6] [u][color=#ffff00]F8[/color][/u][/size]
[/b]
[b]Album Gallery[/b]
A simple menu that lists every character you have [b][color=#dbb0a7][size=3]at least 1 heart with (all characters included)[/size][/color][/b].

[b]Heart-Based Unlocks[/b]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Images unlock as your friendship increases[/size][/color][/b]. Each heart reveals a new image.

[b]Bonus Images at 10 Hearts[/b]
Once you reach [b]10 hearts[/b], [b][color=#a4c2f4][size=3]any extra images for that character unlock automatically[/size][/color][/b].

[b]Unlimited Images[/b]
[b][color=#e06666][size=3]You can add as many images as you want for a character[/size][/color][/b]. The mod automatically loads them from the [b]assets folder[/b].

[b]Simple Navigation[/b]
Browse the gallery using [b][color=#ffd966][size=3]arrow buttons, mouse wheel, or keyboard[/size][/color][/b].

[b]Automatic NPC Detection[/b]
[color=#efefef]To keep the album clean and tidy[/color][color=#00ffff], characters only appear in the album if image files exist for them[/color][color=#6fa8dc].[/color]

[b][color=#dbb0a7][size=6]How It Works:[/size]
[/color][/b]Images are loaded automatically from the [b]assets[/b] folder.

They must follow this naming format:
NPCName_01.png
NPCName_02.png
NPCName_03.png

Example:
Abigail_01.png
Abigail_02.png
Abigail_03.png

If a character reaches [b]10 hearts[/b], [b]all remaining images unlock[/b], even if there are more than ten.


[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]Future Plans: [/size][/color][/b]
[b]In future updates I will make the activation key configurable, as well as  the possibility of  adding JPEG images[/b].
I have more ideas but these two are the main ones. 

[b][color=#d9d2e9]
[size=5]EXTRA INFO TO READ:[/size]
[/color][/b]♦[b]This mod just adds the album[/b] and some example meme photos in the assets folder so you can see how it works.

♦So far, [b]only PNG files can be loaded[/b]. I might put more features in the mod if it gets loved.

♦In order for the characters to appear in the Album, [b]you must have AT LEAST one 01 image[/b]. That means if you have Sebastian images from 4 to 10 but you don't have Sebastian_01, his name won't appear.

♦There are some features that I think I can add to the mod, but that will depend on the interest of the community.


[b][color=#fff2cc][size=6]Incompatibilities: [/size][/color][/b]
This is a mod on its own, the only thing that should be incompatible is any other mod that adds functions with F8, since that's the key to open the album.[/center]

Downloads.Description: By default there are no photos here, input your own photos or download a image pack from nexus.
